faq.q: How much does Southwest Injury Law charge?
faq.a: Southwest Injury Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Southwest Injury Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Southwest Injury Law publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Southwest Injury Law have offices?
faq.a: Southwest Injury Law publishes two offices, among them Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Southwest Injury Law?
faq.a: Southwest Injury Law names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Nevada does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
